privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: This system is used to safely check children in and out during the event. This notice explains what data is held, why, and your rights.
privacy.dataWeCollect: Children's names, date of birth, allergies and medical notes, and parent/guardian contact details. Allergy and medical information is special-category (health) data.
privacy.purpose: To check children in and out, ensure they are released to the right person, and respond to allergies or medical needs during the event.
privacy.legalBasis: Legitimate interest in safeguarding children at the event for most data. Allergy and medical information is only recorded with your explicit, freely given consent; refusing or withdrawing consent does not affect your child's ability to attend.
privacy.retention: Inactive records are anonymised after {days} days. Operational and audit records may be kept longer in anonymised form.
privacy.rights: You may request access to, correction of, or erasure of your data, may object to its processing, and may withdraw your consent to health-data processing at any time. To exercise these rights, contact the data controller below.
privacy.controllerUnconfigured: The operator of this system has not yet published their contact details. Please ask a staff member.
